en: 2. Isis did not want to destroy the Sun. She only wanted him to recognise that he was not absolute.
3. Once named, power stops being pure presence, which is simply there, and can be called, delimited and made to answer for what it does.
Nobody sues the rain, because weather happens and everyone adjusts. That is why, when a loss arrives looking like weather, nobody thinks of complaining, and life goes on.

On platforms the same happens, with more force. It is the screen that decides what appears first, what can be understood and what seems true. Personalising, ranking and measuring are not mere functions of an app, because they carry criteria of value and visibility that guide the behaviour of millions of people.

Code is the set of decisions that defines what a system does. If that code is written by people, it has a direction, and direction can be reconstructed, examined and criticised. There is no fatalism in this, because what was chosen could also have been chosen another way.

So the skin that changes, the character rebuilt from scratch and the punishment that grows until the ban are not natural effects of an evolving technology. They are design decisions, because someone decided it would be so, and it is that decision that can be questioned.

You clicked accept, but you accepted within a frame of language that already left you outside the centre of the relationship. It was not a mistake about a price or a deadline, which can be pointed out and corrected.

Nobody asks for the company's secret or the game's code. What is asked is a demonstrable minimum, enough to see whether there was a relevant change, link it to what was promised and check whether it had a justification and respected predictability, proportion and the chance to challenge. In a dispute, there are instruments to reach that minimum, such as orders to keep and show records, expert examination on defined points and, depending on the case, presumptions against the company.

We are used to looking for abuse in a contract clause, in a sentence that can be underlined and shown to the judge. But there are cases in which no clause, on its own, is the problem.

There are five pieces that organise themselves together and repeat. Noise in the information, which confuses instead of guiding. Friction at the moment of decision, which pushes to one side. Proof beyond the reach of the user. Changes that cannot be checked. And redress that does not cover the loss.

This changes what can be asked. If the platform exercises this kind of power, it needs limits proportional to it. Among them are transparency that serves a purpose, a minimum of stability, verifiable reasons, a real way to challenge and the restoration of what was lost.

The old rules were designed for stable things, delivered at once, whose defect you can see by looking. On their own they cannot handle a product that keeps being altered after the sale. What decides whether you are in this kind of situation is not the item being digital, nor the name the company gives it. It is how much what you use depends on the environment the platform governs.

The focus leaves the businessperson's head and moves to the design. This makes the problem demonstrable, because design is shown through screens, rules, change history and repeated effects, while intention nobody can prove from outside.

And the platform has legitimate purposes, such as security, stability and game balance. The abusive purpose only appears when it can be shown, with reasons, that the design points mainly to exploiting the user's fragility and capturing value disproportionately, and not to those ends.

Read with one caution. None of this is a ready formula or a guarantee of outcome, because each case depends on what happened, on what can be proved and on how the decision-maker reads the facts. What changes is the way the conflict is told, which stops being a loose episode and becomes the way the platform supplies what it sold.
1. When what you buy only exists inside a platform, the sale does not end at the click.
2. The company keeps maintaining, changing and controlling what you use, and that is why it holds duties that follow the purchase for as long as it lasts.
3. What changes is the way the conflict is told, which stops being a loose episode and becomes the way the platform supplies what it sold.
The response looks for what you lost, and the choice is yours
